test.create_query: CREATE TABLE datetime_to_string_primary_key ( k DateTime('UTC') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO datetime_to_string_primary_key SELECT toDateTime(number, 'UTC') FROM numbers(250000000)
OPTIMIZE TABLE datetime_to_string_primary_key FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
test.query: SELECT count() FROM datetime_to_string_primary_key WHERE k IN (SELECT toDateTime(12345678, 'UTC'))
